$comment: Guardrails for the unattended weekly article run (scripts/weekly-article/).
On 2026-08-12 an unattended run drove AppleScript against a live Microsoft Word
session to test watermark survival, hit the wrong document, and removed files
belonging to an unrelated project. A prompt asking it not to would not have
stopped that; a deny rule does. These apply to any Claude session started in
this repository, so an interactive session is bound by them too.
